description: Figure 4 is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of participants (N=6) who highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial. The vertical axis lists seven distinct criteria, ordered from top to bottom as: “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation.” The horizontal axis is labeled “Number of Participants” and ranges from 0 to 6, marked with tick labels at intervals of 2. Each bar corresponds to one criterion and its length indicates the count of participants who found it beneficial: the bar for “Relevant FCs” extends to 6; the bar for “FC Summary” extends to 5; the bars for “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” both extend to 3; the bar for “Overall Summary” extends to 2; and the bars for “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” both extend to 1. All bars are solid-colored, with “Relevant FCs” in dark purple, “FC Summary” in dark blue, “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” in teal, “Overall Summary” in green, and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” in light green. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, with no visual emphasis or annotations applied to any specific bar.
